Admin._comment: NO KEY HERE ON PURPOSE. The admin API's shared secret is a real credential, so it never lives in a tracked file. Supply it locally with 'dotnet user-secrets set Admin:ApiKey <value>', or as the ADERFIA_ADMIN_KEY environment variable. Unset, the admin API refuses every request rather than defaulting to open. See README.md.

Media._comment: ABSOLUTE on purpose. The storefront runs on :5173 and the API on :5099, so a root-relative '/media' would resolve against the frontend origin and 404. In production set this to the CDN origin.
